params.caption: 💸 Nintendo's Black Friday deal: Switch 2 + Mario Kart World back to $500 Nintendo's 2026 Black Friday headliner is the Mario Kart World Switch 2 bundle at $500, down from the $550 it returned at after the original was discontinued. That's the same price as at launch in 2025, and it includes a digital copy of the game plus three months of Nintendo Switch Online. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 17:55 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 🏁 React if you're finally grabbing a Switch 2 · 💬 Real deal or just the old price? #NintendoSwitch2 #BlackFriday #GamingNews
